# Layout contracts

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m uikit docs` from contracts/*.json - do not edit by hand. -->

What a layout must contain for the kit to drive it. The server can only do two things to a
Panorama layout: write a string into a `{s:...}` text slot, and toggle a class on a panel by id.
So a layout *is* its ids, its text slots and the classes its stylesheet reacts to - everything
else (structure, colours, animation) is yours.

## Rules for every component

- **File**: `panorama/layout/custom_game/<name>.xml`. Plugins refer to it by `<name>` only.
- **Root**: the outermost panel is anonymous (the loader owns it); one level in, a panel with
  `id="<name>_root"` authored with class `hidden`. Text slots are addressed through the root id:
  deriving it from the file name keeps two layouts from sharing their text.
- **Marker**: a comment `<!-- uikit:<component> param=value -->` naming the contract and its pool
  sizes. `python -m uikit check-all` validates every layout that has one.
- **Text**: a slot is `text="{s:<var>}"` on a `<Label>`. Same names in every layout of a component -
  that is what makes a custom toast a drop-in for the bundled one.
- **Style**: `style-<name>` on the component's main panel. Define at least `style-neutral`,
  `style-info`, `style-success`, `style-warn`, `style-danger`.
- **Extra slots**: `Texts["footer"]` on any options record is written to `<prefix>_footer`, and
  `Classes` adds free classes on the main panel - for what a custom layout has and the bundled one
  does not.
- **`empty`**: optional text labels get `empty` when blank; collapse them (`visibility: collapse`).
- **Entry**: `show` is added one network update after `hidden` is removed, so a transition on `show`
  has a start state.

## abilities

Per-player ability bar: key, name, cooldown gauge, hold gauge. Tick-friendly.

C#: `AbilityLayout / IAbilityService`

Marker: `<!-- uikit:abilities slots=4 -->`

Pool parameters (marker and C# layout descriptor must agree):

- `slots` (default `4`): Tiles in the pool (AbilityLayout.Slots).

Placeholders: `{n}` = each of `slots`.

| Element | Kind | Required | Kit writes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id="ab_bar"` | panel | yes | `style-*` | The bar. Style = accent. |
| `id="ab_{n}"` | panel | yes | `hidden`, `cooldown`, `holding`, `blocked` | A tile. Author it `hidden`. |
| `id="ab_{n}_bar"` | panel | no | `cd-N`, `run` | Recharge gauge: `cd-N` = N seconds (1..MaxCooldownSeconds), `run` fills it. |
| `id="ab_{n}_hold"` | panel | no | `hold-N`, `run` | Hold gauge: `hold-N` = N tenths of a second (by HoldStepTenths), `run` fills it. |
| `text="{s:ab_{n}_key}"` | Label text | yes | string | AbilitySlot.Key |
| `text="{s:ab_{n}_name}"` | Label text | yes | string | AbilitySlot.Name |
| `text="{s:ab_{n}_cd}"` | Label text | no | string | Seconds left, while `cooldown` |
| `text="{s:ab_<key>}"` | Label text | no | string | AbilityBarOptions.Texts[key] |

Stylesheet should define: `.hidden`, `.cooldown`, `.holding`, `.run`, `.cd-1`, `.hold-5`, `.style-neutral`.

## announce

C#: `AnnounceLayout / IAnnounceService`

Marker: `<!-- uikit:announce -->`

| Element | Kind | Required | Kit writes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id="a_card"` | panel | yes | `hidden`, `show`, `style-*`, `animate-title` | The card. `animate-title` is set when AnnounceOptions.AnimateTitle: animate the title only under it. |
| `id="a_kicker"` | panel | no | `empty` | Label of the kicker, `empty` when blank. |
| `id="a_desc"` | panel | no | `empty` | Label of the description, `empty` when blank. |
| `text="{s:a_title}"` | Label text | yes | string | AnnounceOptions.Title |
| `text="{s:a_kicker}"` | Label text | no | string | AnnounceOptions.Kicker |
| `text="{s:a_desc}"` | Label text | no | string | AnnounceOptions.Description |
| `text="{s:a_<key>}"` | Label text | no | string | AnnounceOptions.Texts[key] |

Stylesheet should define: `.hidden`, `.show`, `.animate-title`, `.style-neutral`, `.style-info`, `.style-success`, `.style-warn`, `.style-danger`.

## menu

Menus and sub-menus: entries paginated by the pool size, back button on sub-menus, pager at the bottom. Takes the mouse.

C#: `MenuLayout / IMenuService`

Marker: `<!-- uikit:menu items=8 choices=6 -->`

Pool parameters (marker and C# layout descriptor must agree):

- `items` (default `8`): Entries per page (MenuLayout.Items).
- `choices` (default `6`): Choices a select's dropdown can list (MenuLayout.Choices); more are ignored.

Placeholders: `{n}` = each of `items`, `{c}` = each of `choices`.

| Element | Kind | Required | Kit writes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id="mn_menu"` | panel | yes | `show`, `style-*`, `no-back`, `no-pager` | Everything under the root. `show` plays the entry; style-* = accent; `no-back` on a root menu; `no-pager` with a single page. |
| `id="mn_close"` | button | yes | click | Close button (click). |
| `id="mn_back"` | button | yes | click | Back to the parent menu (click). Hide it under `no-back`. |
| `id="mn_prev"` | button | yes | `disabled` | Previous page (click), `disabled` on the first page. |
| `id="mn_next"` | button | yes | `disabled` | Next page (click), `disabled` on the last page. |
| `id="mn_subtitle"` | panel | no | `empty` | Label of the subtitle, `empty` when blank. |
| `id="mn_path"` | panel | no | `empty` | Label of the breadcrumb, `empty` on a root menu. |
| `id="mn_entry_{n}"` | panel | yes | `hidden`, `kind-button`, `kind-toggle`, `kind-select`, `kind-submenu`, `on`, `open`, `style-*`, `disabled` | An entry. Author it `hidden`. `kind-*` decides which parts show: the arrow (submenu), the switch (toggle, `on` = enabled), the value and caret (button, select); `open` shows a select's dropdown. |
| `id="mn_item_{n}"` | button | yes | click | The entry's row (click). Inside `mn_entry_{n}`. |
| `id="mn_item_{n}_desc"` | panel | no | `empty` | Label of the entry description, `empty` when blank. |
| `id="mn_item_{n}_value"` | panel | no | `empty` | Label of the entry value, `empty` when blank. |
| `id="mn_choice_{n}_{c}"` | button | no | `hidden`, `active` | A choice of the select's dropdown (click). Author it `hidden`. `active` = the current choice. Needed only for menus with a select. |
| `text="{s:mn_title}"` | Label text | yes | string | MenuOptions.Title |
| `text="{s:mn_subtitle}"` | Label text | no | string | MenuOptions.Subtitle |
| `text="{s:mn_path}"` | Label text | no | string | Titles of the open menus, root first |
| `text="{s:mn_page}"` | Label text | no | string | "page / pages" |
| `text="{s:mn_item_{n}_label}"` | Label text | yes | string | MenuEntry.Label |
| `text="{s:mn_item_{n}_desc}"` | Label text | no | string | MenuEntry.Description |
| `text="{s:mn_item_{n}_value}"` | Label text | no | string | MenuEntry.Value, or the current choice of a select |
| `text="{s:mn_choice_{n}_{c}_label}"` | Label text | no | string | A choice of a select |
| `text="{s:mn_<key>}"` | Label text | no | string | MenuOptions.Texts[key] |

Stylesheet should define: `.hidden`, `.show`, `.empty`, `.no-back`, `.no-pager`, `.style-neutral`, `.style-info`, `.style-success`, `.style-warn`, `.style-danger`, `.kind-button`, `.kind-toggle`, `.kind-select`, `.kind-submenu`, `.on`, `.open`, `.active`, `.disabled`.

## panel

Pool parameters (marker and C# layout descriptor must agree):

- `pages` (default `8`): Menu entries (PanelLayout.Pages).
- `stats` (default `4`): Chips above the rows (PanelLayout.Stats).
- `rows` (default `24`): Rows of the selected page (PanelLayout.Rows).

Placeholders: `{n}` = each of `pages`, `{s}` = each of `stats`, `{r}` = each of `rows`.

| Element | Kind | Required | Kit writes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id="p_panel"` | panel | yes | `show`, `style-*`, `no-hint` | Everything under the root. `show` plays the entry; style-* = accent; `no-hint` hides the footer. |
| `id="p_close"` | button | yes | click | Close button (click). |
| `id="p_page_{n}"` | button | yes | `hidden`, `active` | Menu entry (click switches page). Author it `hidden`. |
| `id="p_stats"` | panel | no | `hidden` | Stat strip, `hidden` when the page has no stat. |
| `id="p_stat_{s}"` | panel | no | `hidden`, `style-*`, `no-key` | Stat chip. Author it `hidden`. `no-key` when the key is blank. |
| `id="p_row_{r}"` | panel | yes | `hidden`, `kind-header`, `kind-action`, `kind-toggle`, `kind-info`, `kind-stepper`, `kind-text`, `kind-paragraph`, `style-*`, `on`, `disabled`, `selected`, `nested`, `no-title`, `no-desc` | Row of the selected page. `kind-*` decides which parts show. Author it `hidden`. |
| `id="p_row_{r}_btn"` | button | no | click | Row button (kind-action, click). |
| `id="p_row_{r}_toggle"` | button | no | click | Row switch (kind-toggle, click). |
| `id="p_row_{r}_prev"` | button | no | click | Stepper ‹ (kind-stepper, click). |
| `id="p_row_{r}_next"` | button | no | click | Stepper › (kind-stepper, click). |
| `text="{s:p_title}"` | Label text | yes | string | PanelOptions.Title |
| `text="{s:p_subtitle}"` | Label text | no | string | PanelOptions.Subtitle |
| `text="{s:p_hint}"` | Label text | no | string | PanelOptions.Hint |
| `text="{s:p_page_{n}_label}"` | Label text | yes | string | PanelPage.Label |
| `text="{s:p_stat_{s}_key}"` | Label text | no | string | PanelStat.Key |
| `text="{s:p_stat_{s}_value}"` | Label text | no | string | PanelStat.Value |
| `text="{s:p_row_{r}_title}"` | Label text | yes | string | PanelRow.Title |
| `text="{s:p_row_{r}_desc}"` | Label text | no | string | PanelRow.Description |
| `text="{s:p_row_{r}_value}"` | Label text | no | string | PanelRow.Value (info value, stepper choice) |
| `text="{s:p_row_{r}_btn}"` | Label text | no | string | PanelRow.Button |
| `text="{s:p_<key>}"` | Label text | no | string | PanelOptions.Texts[key] |

## roulette

Case-opening roulette: a strip of cards slows down on a server-drawn winner. Per player.

C#: `RouletteLayout / IRouletteService`

Marker: `<!-- uikit:roulette cells=31 winner=24 -->`

Pool parameters (marker and C# layout descriptor must agree):

- `cells` (default `31`): Cards on the strip (RouletteLayout.Cells).
- `winner` (default `24`): Card the strip stops on (RouletteLayout.WinnerCell). The stylesheet's jit-N offsets are built for it.

Placeholders: `{n}` = each of `cells`.

| Element | Kind | Required | Kit writes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id="r_screen"` | panel | yes | `show`, `style-*` | The screen. Style = accent colour. |
| `id="r_kicker"` | panel | no | `empty` | Label of the kicker, `empty` when blank. |
| `id="r_strip"` | panel | yes | `dur-N`, `jit-0`, `jit-1`, `jit-2`, `jit-3`, `jit-4`, `spin`, `settle`, `done`, `no-sub` | The strip of cards. `dur-N` (N in RouletteLayout.Durations) is the total time, `jit-0`..`jit-4` where in the winner's card it stops, `spin` moves it most of the way at full speed, `settle` (added RouletteLayout.SettleAfterFraction of the time later) slows it onto the winner's card, `done` once it has stopped, `no-sub` when no item has a second line. |
| `id="r_cell_{n}"` | panel | yes | `style-*`, `won` | A card. Style = the item's rarity colour, `won` on the winner's card once the strip has stopped. |
| `id="r_cell_{n}_sub"` | panel | no | `empty` | Second line of a card, `empty` when the item has none. |
| `id="r_result"` | panel | no | `hidden` | Result line, `hidden` until the strip has stopped. |
| `id="r_result_sub"` | panel | no | `empty` | Second line of the result, `empty` when the item has none. |
| `text="{s:r_title}"` | Label text | yes | string | RouletteOptions.Title |
| `text="{s:r_kicker}"` | Label text | no | string | RouletteOptions.Kicker |
| `text="{s:r_cell_{n}_name}"` | Label text | yes | string | RouletteItem.Name |
| `text="{s:r_cell_{n}_sub}"` | Label text | no | string | RouletteItem.Sub |
| `text="{s:r_result_label}"` | Label text | no | string | RouletteOptions.ResultLabel |
| `text="{s:r_result_name}"` | Label text | no | string | Name of the item drawn. |
| `text="{s:r_result_sub}"` | Label text | no | string | Sub of the item drawn. |
| `text="{s:r_<key>}"` | Label text | no | string | RouletteOptions.Texts[key] |

Stylesheet should define: `.show`, `.hidden`, `.empty`, `.spin`, `.settle`, `.done`, `.won`, `.no-sub`, `.style-neutral`, `.style-info`, `.style-success`, `.style-warn`, `.style-danger`.

## toast

Stacked, auto-dismissing notifications. A fixed pool of cards per placement.

C#: `ToastLayout / IToastService`

Marker: `<!-- uikit:toast placements=tl,tc,tr,ml,mr,bl,bc,br depth=4 -->`

Pool parameters (marker and C# layout descriptor must agree):

- `placements` (default `tl,tc,tr,ml,mr,bl,bc,br`): Placement codes the layout has a stack for (ToastLayout.Placements).
- `depth` (default `4`): Cards per placement (ToastLayout.Depth).

Placeholders: `{p}` = each of `placements`, `{n}` = each of `depth`.

| Element | Kind | Required | Kit writes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id="t_{p}_{n}"` | panel | yes | `hidden`, `show`, `style-*`, `anim-from-left`, `anim-from-right`, `anim-from-top`, `anim-from-bottom`, `anim-fade` | The card. Author it with class `hidden`. `anim-*` is the side it rests on while not `show`. |
| `id="t_{p}_{n}_kicker"` | panel | no | `empty` | Label of the kicker, `empty` when blank. |
| `id="t_{p}_{n}_desc"` | panel | no | `empty` | Label of the description, `empty` when blank. |
| `id="t_{p}_{n}_track"` | panel | no | `has-progress` | Progress track, `has-progress` while the toast has a duration. |
| `id="t_{p}_{n}_bar"` | panel | no | `dur-N`, `run` | Progress bar: `dur-N` (N in ToastLayout.Durations) sets the transition, `run` drains it. Use `clip`, not `width`. |
| `text="{s:t_{p}_{n}_title}"` | Label text | yes | string | ToastOptions.Title |
| `text="{s:t_{p}_{n}_kicker}"` | Label text | no | string | ToastOptions.Kicker |
| `text="{s:t_{p}_{n}_desc}"` | Label text | no | string | ToastOptions.Description |
| `text="{s:t_{p}_{n}_<key>}"` | Label text | no | string | ToastOptions.Texts[key] |

Stylesheet should define: `.hidden`, `.show`, `.style-neutral`, `.style-info`, `.style-success`, `.style-warn`, `.style-danger`, `.anim-from-left`, `.anim-from-right`, `.anim-from-top`, `.anim-from-bottom`, `.anim-fade`.

## vote

Screen of a vote: question, choices with live counts, countdown, clicks. Per player. Takes the mouse.

C#: `VoteLayout / IVoteService`

Marker: `<!-- uikit:vote choices=5 -->`

Pool parameters (marker and C# layout descriptor must agree):

- `choices` (default `5`): Choice buttons per page (VoteLayout.Choices). A longer vote is paged.

Placeholders: `{n}` = each of `choices`.

| Element | Kind | Required | Kit writes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id="vt_screen"` | panel | yes | `show`, `locked`, `no-close`, `no-pager`, `style-*` | The screen. Style = accent colour, `locked` once the vote takes no more clicks, `no-close` hides the close button, `no-pager` hides the pager (one page). |
| `id="vt_kicker"` | panel | no | `empty` | Label of the kicker, `empty` when blank. |
| `id="vt_close"` | button | yes | click | Close button (click). Hide it under `no-close`. |
